_comment: Default gates for scripts/airtribe_bridge.py verify. Run inside a fresh detached worktree of mycohort-api at the exact candidate SHA. Full `pnpm test` is NOT a gate: it carries baseline failures (Node 26 vs jsonwebtoken); reactor/verify.sh compares that count against reactor/baseline.json instead.

default_gates.name: jest: tests related to files changed since master
eslint: changed js files
argv: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR master...HEAD -- '*.js' | xargs -r npx eslint --max-warnings=0

default_gates.name: prettier: changed js files
argv: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR master...HEAD -- '*.js' | xargs -r npx prettier --check
